Container.Name: BuildHub
Container.Overview:
Offline parts search and AI-assisted BOM generation for electronics and 3D-printing (RepRap) builds. Crawls electronics/maker marketplaces and component distributors into a local, offline-searchable catalog; paste or AI-generate a parts list and get the cheapest source per line with links, using landed cost (unit price x MOQ + shipping), never unit price alone.
Set BUILDHUB_ADMIN_TOKEN before exposing this beyond your LAN -- without it the admin pages (which mutate the catalog) refuse to serve from a non-loopback address, which every container connection is. AI BOM generation is optional and off by default -- set AI_PROVIDER to enable it with a cloud API key or a local Ollama instance.
Requires --shm-size=1g (below in Extra Parameters) -- several adapters render pages in a real Chromium, and Docker's default 64MB /dev/shm makes that crash silently.
Container.Description: Offline parts search and AI-assisted BOM generation for electronics and 3D-printing builds, with links to real listings and landed-cost comparison.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, media, browser profile and editable YAML config

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unraid's nobody user -- keeps appdata editable from the host

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone the crawl schedule is interpreted in

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: serve = web UI + scheduler; web = UI only; schedule = crawler only

Config.Name: Admin Token
Config.Description: Required to reach /admin from a container. Any long random string; used as the HTTP Basic password.

Config.Name: AI Provider
Config.Description: Optional: none | anthropic | ollama. Enables AI-generated BOMs from a plain-language build description.

Config.Name: AI API Key
Config.Description: Only used when AI Provider = anthropic

Config.Name: Ollama Base URL
Config.Description: Only used when AI Provider = ollama. Point at a local/LAN Ollama instance.

Config.Name: Translate Provider
Config.Description: Optional: none | claude | deepl | google_free. Needed to merge non-English listings by title.

Config.Name: Octopart Client ID
Config.Description: Free Nexar key: https://nexar.com -- aggregates Mouser/Digi-Key/LCSC pricing by part number

Config.Name: eBay Client ID
Config.Description: Optional -- without it the eBay baseline falls back to browser scraping
